about.description: JDON is a single-stock perpetual listed on Gate, tracking JD.com, Inc., margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Gate prices this market off the Ondo tokenized stock for JD.com, Inc., a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 20× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
